name: Botswana

flag.description: A light blue field crossed horizontally through the middle by a black band edged with thin white stripes.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents water and rain, echoing the national motto 'Pula'; the black and white bands stand for racial harmony and recall the zebra, the national animal.

hook: Botswana paints a single white-edged black zebra stripe across a pale blue sky; the blue is 'pula', rain.
trivia: Botswana's currency, the pula, is named after the Setswana word for rain, which is also the national motto.
Botswana is home to the world's largest population of African elephants, estimated at around 130,000.
